title: Services, Networking & DNS
summary: The Kubernetes network model, Service types and how kube-proxy implements them, EndpointSlices, cluster DNS with CoreDNS, LoadBalancers on kind, and a systematic way to debug connectivity.
objectives: Explain the Kubernetes network model and the role of the CNI plugin
Choose between ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName and headless Services
Explain how selectors produce EndpointSlices and how readiness affects them
Describe how kube-proxy implements Services in iptables, IPVS and nftables modes
Use port, targetPort, nodePort and named ports correctly; configure session affinity and traffic policies
Explain cluster DNS names, search domains and ndots, and their performance impact
Provision LoadBalancer Services on kind with cloud-provider-kind
Debug Service connectivity systematically with netshoot, nslookup, curl and EndpointSlices
